tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Certificate Verification

Certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included; the earlier practice of disabling it in development no longer applies. Testing that needs a certificate uses self-signed certificates rather than turning verification off. Connections use HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception, since proper certificate management is now in place.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
